items.description: A fully-formed transaction record for bulk import via /transactions/batch.

type.description: How the transaction entered the system.

walletId.description: Integration account id the row came from.

csvLink.description: Storage link to the source CSV.

syncId.description: Sync run id that produced this row.

items.description: An asset leg flowing INTO the workspace (received). `type` must be 'incoming'.

asset.description: A raw, un-matched asset descriptor used inside transaction asset legs.

type.description: Asset class. Used to drive matching and tax treatment.

chainId.description: Chain identifier the asset lives on.

contractAddress.description: Token contract address (for on-chain tokens / NFTs).

asset.title: RawAsset

price.description: A point-in-time price for an asset leg, in the given base currency.
Unit price in baseCurrency — never a line total. Multiply by the leg quantity to get its fiat value (the API already does this for the leg `value` and for `netValue`).

baseCurrency.description: ISO currency code the price is denominated in.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch (ms) the price was observed.

source.description: Pricing source identifier. `custom` marks a workspace price override; `derived` marks a price inferred from the priced side of a two-sided trade by value conservation (counter-value ÷ quantity) rather than quoted by a provider.

price.title: PriceModel
